conviction_note: The H1 print is confirmed for 2026-09-25 but VIGO has released every quarterly and half-year report after the Warsaw close (17:03-19:57 CEST), so the reaction lands on Monday 2026-09-28 and the defaulted bmo window (close 09-24 to close 09-25) should hold approximately nothing. Revenue (+70.8% y/y in Q2, 34.7m PLN) was pre-released by ESPI on 2026-07-08, so the only unknown left is the margin. Q2 2025 had 0.5m PLN of EBITDA on 20.3m of revenue, and Q1 2026 adjusted EBITDA of 3.3m against Ipopema's 1.1m forecast was followed by +5.8%, so the arithmetic points to a positive margin read. That read is an inference from the cost base rather than a document, and I cannot source a Q2 EBITDA bar at all, so the one finding is capped at +0.5. The emitted +0.4 is a little under it because the 5-day run-up of +5% leaves some of the optimism in the price already.

findings.finding: With Q2 2026 revenue already out at 34.7m PLN (+70.8% y/y; 26.1m standalone, +28%, plus about 8.4m from InfraRed Associates) against a Q2 2025 base of 0.5m PLN EBITDA on 20.3m of revenue, and Q1 2026 adj. EBITDA at 3.3m on 19.3m of revenue, operating leverage on a largely fixed cost base points to a record Q2 EBITDA somewhere in the 5-9m PLN range. Margin is the one line the pre-release did not disclose.

findings.why_not_priced: The revenue has been public since July, but the price after it was set by supply rather than by the margin. Two sessions later the company launched an ABB of 131,219 new shares plus Warsaw Equity's full 124,800-share exit, and the stock fell -7.41% on 2026-07-15 to the 480 PLN issue price. It is at 506 now, below the 550 of the July 8 close and far below 626 in June. If the margin step-up were priced, the stock would have re-rated off the placement price toward Ipopema's 650-670 targets rather than drifting 455-512 through September. Only one broker covers the name. Counter-weights: the +4.98% 5-day run-up, and the absence of any sourced EBITDA bar, mean this is capped.
findings.independence: The operating-leverage argument is partly corroborated by a different source, the company's own English press release (https://vigophotonics.com/vigo-photonics-revenue-estimates-for-q2-2026/): record quarter, backlog of 92.9m PLN, more than 3x y/y. That is revenue and backlog, not margin, so the EBITDA read itself has no independent document. Risks to the number, all inference: purchase-price accounting on the InfraRed Associates assets, acquisition costs (Q1 G&A rose +29%, 'jednorazowymi kosztami związanymi z akwizycją'), interest on the PKO BP/PFR/KUKE facilities, and FX on USD revenue.

outside_window.finding: TFI PZU (>5% holder) requisitioned an EGM to change the supervisory board ('Podjęcie uchwał w sprawie zmian w Radzie Nadzorczej'), convened for 2026-10-29. This is a governance move while the strategic-options review opened in September 2024 is still running, and Ipopema expects that review to end in 2026.

Under China's dual-use export ban (MOFCOM, 2026-07-24), the company estimates that about half of semiconductor-materials segment revenue relied on Chinese InP substrates. The segment was 8.8% of 2025 revenue, so about 4% of group revenue is at risk from Q3 onward. The detector and matrix lines are unaffected, with more than a year of substrate stock on hand. The H1 report may quantify this, but the revenue effect falls in H2.

Under the PCO framework annex, the matrix test batch is due in Q4 2026, with a minimum-volume framework of 191.86m PLN for 2027-2032. The 63m PLN ABB at 480 funds that production line, so the financing buys a documented ramp rather than signalling distress.

'Size one-offs as one-offs': the Strupiński claim draft (-0.2) was dropped into searched_and_found_nothing, because a provision is unlikely given the board and counsel's 'baseless' assessment and the item has no path to the guide.
